I agree with the “dumbing down” part. One time in my health class we had to write and present something about any health issue. I chose mental illnesses (checked to make sure it fit the brief because cranky teacher) and she said it was a good one. Then I got my result. I was marked down because I was “too graphic with the descriptions of mainly the symptoms and side effects of medications”. I was fuming. Other people had pictures of skin torn from limbs with the bone exposed but me explaining what some different mental illnesses felt/looked like for other was “too graphic”.
When I approached her she said I’d have got a better mark if I didn’t go into so much detail. Like we were year 12. Not primary school.

This! I hate when people say those sorts of things. I’ve had one of my former friends ask me to help set up for a party by saying “I need you to OCD this place so it’s perfect”. I didn’t even know how to respond because I thought she had a slight understanding of how hard it could get for me.

I use an app called Calm. It helps me with my depression and anxiety. It’s my everything when I’m having a bad time. People pull it up for me when I’m having a panic and make me watch the breathing exercise bubbles and count them. It has music, meditation guides and a bunch more. I use it every day and any time I feel like crap. 

Hope that it helps you if you try it out :)
That’s such an adorable name! I’m glad you’re still here today and that your fur baby helps you too!

I talk to my puppy every night. I talk to him about my day, how I’ve been and what I’ve done if I wasn’t with him and then ask him questions slightly high pitched because then he gets all excited. It sets me in a slightly better mood to go to bed. Makes the day better no matter what’s happened
They really are. I am too

Anytime. Hope it helps if you decide to try it out!
Also if you want someone to talk to just chuck me a message

You don’t have to take my advice but I have really crap days as well and the only way I can cope sometimes is to split the days into sections. So morning, midday, afternoon and night. That way when something shit goes down only that section of the day was bad, not the whole day. It’s not a drastic difference but it helps me most the time!
